21.short: A 200mm x 200mm floor waste in 316 stainless steel with a heel-proof 3mm wedge wire grate and a DN100 (89mm) outlet. Made for balconies, patios, alfresco areas and pool surrounds.
21.body:
The Neston 200mm square floor waste gives an outdoor area a single, generous collection point with a clean wedge wire finish. It is made from 316 stainless steel, the grade used across the whole Neston range, with a polished finish and a 3mm wedge wire grate that is heel proof for pedestrian areas.

Where it suits: balconies, patios, alfresco areas and pool surrounds where a square point drain suits the layout better than a linear channel.

Installation: the floor waste is 32mm deep with a DN100 (89mm) outlet. The connection to the stormwater or drainage system, the falls to the waste and the membrane detail are set by the plumber and waterproofer for the area. Installation must be done by a licensed plumber, and external waterproofing (balconies and decks) is done to AS 4654 by a qualified applicator.

Care: lift the grate and rinse out debris regularly, especially near pools and garden beds.

Size200mm x 200mm
Depth32mm
Material316 stainless steel
FinishPolished
Grate3mm wedge wire, heel proof
OutletDN100 (89mm)

FAQ

What outlet does it have?
DN100 (89mm).

Is the grate heel proof?
Yes, the 3mm wedge wire grate is heel proof.

Can I use it beside a pool?
It is 316 stainless steel, the grade Neston uses for coastal and pool areas. Rinse it regularly to remove chlorine and salt deposits.

Who installs it?
A licensed plumber, with external waterproofing to AS 4654.

34.short: A 1000mm linear wedge wire drain kit in brushed 316 stainless steel: 105mm x 24mm V-bottom channel, heel-proof 3mm wedge wire grate, and loose end caps and outlet so it can be cut to length on site. DN100 or DN80 outlet.
34.body:
The Neston Linear Wedge Wire Drain is made for the places water collects outside: alfresco areas, pool surrounds, balconies, garage and building entries. The grate is 3mm wedge wire bars with 3mm gaps (heel proof), and the whole kit is 316 stainless steel in a brushed finish.

Cut-to-size kit. The kit comes with a pair of loose end caps and a loose outlet. The channel can be cut to the length the job needs (up to 1000mm), the outlet hole drilled where the waste is with a hole saw, and the outlet fixed with Sikaflex 11FC adhesive or similar. The drain is fitted to the site, not the other way around.

V-bottom channel. The 24mm deep channel has a V-bottom for better flow performance and easier cleaning.

Outlet sizes: DN100 (89mm), code NS105WW24SS-1000DN100, or DN80 (76mm), code NS105WW24SS-1000DN80.

Length1000mm kit (cut to size)
Channel105mm wide x 24mm deep, V-bottom
Material / finish316 stainless steel, brushed
GrateWedge wire, 3mm bar, 3mm space, heel proof
OutletDN100 (89mm) or DN80 (76mm)
In the kitChannel, grate, loose end caps, loose outlet
WaterMarkWaterMark Approved

FAQ

Can I cut it shorter?
Yes. The kit is designed to be cut to size, with loose end caps supplied.

Can the outlet go anywhere along the channel?
The outlet is loose, so the plumber drills the outlet hole where it is needed and fixes the outlet in place.

Is there an installation guide?
Yes, see below.

Installation Instructions

Download the Neston Linear Wedge Wire Drain installation instructions (PDF). Installation must be done by a licensed plumber and waterproofer. Longer runs: the same drain comes in 1500mm and 2000mm kits. Read more in Outdoor Linear Drains.

235.short: A deeper 105mm x 52mm channel in brushed 316 stainless steel with a 20mm deep heel-proof wedge wire grate, designed for zero-threshold entries. 1000mm kit, cut to size on site, with a loose DN100 or DN80 outlet.
235.body:
Where a doorway, balcony or building entry has no step, the drain at the threshold does more work. The Neston 52mm Deep Linear Wedge Wire Drain has a rebated 52mm deep channel and a 20mm deep wedge wire grate (3mm bars, 3mm gaps, heel proof), in brushed 316 stainless steel.

Zero-threshold entries. The channel is designed to help a level entry meet the step-down detailing used for zero-threshold entries under NCC 2022. Whether the entry complies depends on the whole design: the falls, the membrane, the threshold detail and the drainage connection. See Zero Threshold Drains for Building Entries.

Cut-to-size kit. A pair of loose end caps and a loose outlet are included. Cut the channel to length, drill the outlet hole with a hole saw and fix the outlet with Sikaflex 11FC adhesive or similar.

Outlet sizes: DN100 (89mm), code NS105WW52SS-1000DN100, or DN80 (76mm), code NS105WW52SS-1000DN80. Choose the outlet from the Outlet Size option when you order.

V-bottom channel for flow performance and easier cleaning.

Length1000mm kit (cut to size)
Channel105mm x 52mm, rebated, V-bottom
Grate20mm deep wedge wire, 3mm bar / 3mm space, heel proof
Material / finish316 stainless steel, brushed
OutletLoose DN100 (89mm) or DN80 (76mm), selected when you order
WaterMarkWaterMark Approved

FAQ

Why 52mm deep?
The deeper, rebated channel suits threshold and entry details where more depth is needed under the grate.

Is it NCC compliant?
A drain alone cannot make an entry compliant. This drain is designed to help a zero-threshold entry meet NCC 2022 detailing; the whole installation has to comply.

What outlet does it have?
A loose DN100 (89mm) or DN80 (76mm) outlet: choose it from the Outlet Size option.

23.short: A 1200mm linear tile insert drain in PVD brushed brass over 316 stainless steel. The tray takes tile up to 10mm, so the floor runs through the drain and only a fine brass line shows. DN100, DN80 or DN40 outlet.
23.body:
Brushed brass is one of Neston's five matched finishes, alongside brushed stainless, brushed bronze, gun metal and matte black. Because the same finishes run across the linear, square and outdoor ranges, a brass linear drain in the shower can match brass square grates elsewhere in the project. See all five on the finishes page.

Built in 316 stainless. Under the PVD brushed brass finish, the channel is 316 stainless steel: 105mm x 24mm, with a folded edge for strength and a V-bottom for flow performance and easier cleaning.

Tile insert tray. Takes floor tile up to 10mm thick.

Kit form. Loose end caps for the channel and tile insert tray, and a loose outlet, so the drain can be cut to length and the outlet positioned on site. Drill the outlet hole with a hole saw and fix the outlet with Sikaflex 11FC adhesive or similar.

Outlet sizes: DN100 (89mm) NS105TI24BB-1200DN100 · DN80 (76mm) NS105TI24BB-1200DN80 · DN40 (38mm) NS105TI24BB-1200DN40.

Will it match brass tapware?
We can't guarantee a match to another brand's finish. Ask for a sample through your reseller or talk to Neston.

26.short: The longest Neston tile insert kit: 1200mm of brushed 316 stainless steel for wider showers, wet rooms and wall-to-wall drains. Tile up to 10mm, cut to size on site, DN100, DN80 or DN40 outlet.
26.body:
Choose the 1200mm kit when the drain needs to run the full width of a wider shower or a wet room, or where a wall-to-wall drain sits at the entry of a level-access shower. For shorter runs, the 1000mm kit uses the same channel.

Cut on site. The channel and tile insert tray can be cut down to the exact length on site. The kit includes loose end caps for both and a loose outlet. The end caps and outlet are fitted by a licensed plumber; a hole saw for the outlet isn't included.

Channel and tray. 105mm wide x 24mm deep V-bottom channel in brushed 316 stainless steel; tile insert tray for tile up to 10mm.

Outlet sizes: DN100 (89mm) NS105TI24SS-1200DN100 · DN80 (76mm) NS105TI24SS-1200DN80 · DN40 (38mm) NS105TI24SS-1200DN40, which suits 50mm outlet pipe where a puddle flange has a 40mm internal throat.

OutletDN100, DN80 or DN40

FAQ

1000mm or 1200mm?
Pick the kit at or just over the length you need and cut it down on site.

Does the DN40 outlet fit 40mm pipe?
No. It suits 50mm pipe with a puddle flange that has a 40mm internal throat.

No.
